escalation.title: Escalation process
escalation.hint: When and how to hand a ticket up.
escalation.body:
Escalate when a customer is blocked, money is at stake, or you have tried twice without progress.

Before you escalate

  • Read the ticket's history and search the wiki.

  • Write down what you tried.

Steps

  1. Set the ticket to urgent.

  2. Leave an internal note with what the customer needs.

  3. Assign it to the lead on call.

  4. Tell the customer who has it now and when they will hear back.

Who is on call

Add your rota, or a link to it, here.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.hint: Who can refund what, and when.
refunds.body:
Who can refund what, and when.

The rule

Refund any charge within 30 days, no questions asked.

Exceptions

  • Duplicate charges: refund at once and apologize.

  • Over 100 euros: a lead approves it first.

  • Chargebacks: don't refund twice. Hand the ticket to billing.

How to refund

  1. Find the charge in the billing tool.

  2. Refund it and note the amount on the ticket.

onboarding.title: Onboarding checklist
onboarding.hint: A new teammate's first two weeks.
onboarding.body:
What a new teammate does in their first two weeks.

Week one

  • Get access to the helpdesk, chat and billing tools.

  • Read the escalation process and the refund policy.

  • Shadow a teammate for two shifts.

Week two

  • Answer tickets with a buddy reviewing your drafts.

  • Take your own queue for half a day.
